thread:
Rohan: quick sync: planning an SI onboarding pilot focused on hardware-enabled integrations + marketplace listing readiness. want to pin acceptance criteria and the runbook steps.
Priya: thumbs up. suggest we split into 3 tracks: infra access, marketplace listing, and joint announcement comms.
Ben: +1. infra access usually causes the most friction. propose a 'hardware voucher matrix' that maps vendor -> voucher type -> lead time.
Claire: can you sketch the matrix? I can take vendor outreach.
Ben: sketch attached (spreadsheet link): https://drive.example/hw-vouchers-matrix
Priya: for marketplace listing, we need a minimal metadata set so SI can publish quickly. propose fields:
```
- solution_name
- si_partner_name
- supported_models
- deployment_modes (hosted/dedicated/private)
- hw_requirements
- contact_email
- listing_assets (1xarch-diagram, 1xthumb)
```
Rohan: nice. add a compliance flag and preferred region. also we should auto-generate a short blurb from a template.
Claire: on announcements: we should reserve a joint-announce slot 2 weeks after pilot success. sales-bot, can you flag SDRs and AMs?
sales-bot: flagged. creating task SLS-442. pinging AM leads for go/no-go.
Ben: runbook outline I propose:
1) intake form (SI + solution short form)
2) vendor voucher request (ops approves)
3) infra smoke test (30m)
4) marketplace draft (fill metadata)
5) enablement session (60m workshop)
6) certification sign-off -> publish listing
Priya: certification sign-off: we need clear pass criteria. suggest two-tier cert: Bronze (deployment checklist pass), Silver (+monitoring + alerts), Gold (+SLA verification + load test).
Claire: love tiers. define tests for each tier. Bronze = deploy demo app + smoke tests. Silver = attach monitoring + alerting policy and create runbook. Gold = run 5k-req load test at 95th pct latency target.
Rohan: timeline: pilot with 2 SIs over 4 weeks. week0 intake, week1 voucher + smoke, week2 marketplace + enablement, week3 certification + go/no-go.
Priya: capacity: need 2 enablement leads; can we borrow from Solutions Eng for weeks 2-3?
Ben: yes, I'll coordinate. also flagging procurement hold for certain vendor NDAs. add a procurement gate at intake.
Claire: communications: prepare a one-pager for partners with steps and SLAs. I can draft.
Rohan: ops-bot, can you provision a temporary repo template for marketplace assets and a CI job that validates the metadata schema?
ops-bot: creating infra ticket INF-2197. will add repo template under org/si-marketplace-stubs and a GitHub Actions CI that checks a JSON schema. ETA 4 days.
Priya: on-line exam? instead of full exam, do a short lab-run checklist session during the enablement workshop and capture artifacts (logs, screenshots). that reduces friction.
Ben: agree. capture artifacts in partner repo under /evidence. we can use that as the basis for cert issuance.
Claire: pilot acceptance criteria (proposed):
- 2 SI teams complete Bronze cert within 21 days
- marketplace drafts submitted with metadata and assets
- no critical vendor access blockers unresolved
- sales sign-off for joint-announce
Rohan: solid. next steps:
- Claire: draft partner one-pager + announce template (due 3 days)
- Ben: finish voucher matrix + vendor outreach (due 5 days)
- Priya: write metadata schema + CI JSON schema (due 4 days)
- Ops-bot: INF-2197 provisioning (ETA 4 days)
ops-bot: tickets created: INF-2197, SLS-442. will update when repos are ready.
Rohan: thanks team. planning a 20m review next Friday to confirm pilot roster. ping if you hit blockers.
